description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Luther Burden III was practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Burden had returned to practice last week. He is on track to be good to go for the start of the season next week.
items.title: Luther Burden III (groin) practices Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bears say Kyle Monangai remains week-to-week.
items.impact: Monangai has been considered week-to-week for the past couple of weeks. It appears he won't be ready to go to begin the season, which should lead to a workhorse role for D'Andre Swift to open the year.
items.title: Kyle Monangai (knee) remains week-to-week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bengals signed QB Josh Johnson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Johnson returns as the QB3 for the Bengals after they had released him.
items.title: Josh Johnson signs with Bengals practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed RB Jaleel McLaughlin to their practice squad.
items.impact: McLaughlin had been waived by the Broncos. He will add depth in the backfield for Cleveland.
items.title: Jaleel McLaughlin signs with Browns practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Chargers signed QB DJ Uiagalelei to their practice squad.
items.impact: Uiagalelei was previously waived by the Chargers. He returns in a depth role in their quarterback room.
items.title: DJ Uiagalelei signs with Chargers practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Raiders GM John Spytek said Ashton Jeanty is in a "good spot" and "could return sooner than expected."
items.impact: "I expect him to be back as quick he can, maybe quicker than some people would expect," Spytek said. "When that is, we'll see." Jeanty did not practice on Tuesday. The fact that he wasn't placed on IR is a positive sign. He could be back as soon as Week 1.
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) receives positive update

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys signed OT Wanya Morris to their practice squad.
items.impact: Morris was waived by the Falcons. He will add depth on the offensive line for Dallas.
items.title: Wanya Morris signs with Cowboys practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders placed EDGE Keyron Crawford on season-ending injured reserve.
items.impact: Crawford suffered a season-ending ankle injury in his final preseason game. The rookie third-round pick will look to get fully healthy for next season.
items.title: Keyron Crawford placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles placed TE Grant Calcaterra on injured reserve.
items.impact: Calcaterra will miss at least the first four weeks of the season. It is unclear what injury he is dealing with.
items.title: Grant Calcaterra placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alvin Kamara did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: It remains unclear when Kamara will be able to return. It is notable he wasn't placed on IR.
items.title: Alvin Kamara (knee) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals placed TE Tip Reiman on the reserve/PUP list.
items.impact: Reiman will miss at least the first four weeks of the season. He'll add depth in the tight end room when he is healthy.
items.title: Tip Reiman (ankle) placed on reserve/PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Theo Johnson practiced on Tuesday wearing a non-contact jersey.
items.impact: Johnson will have the next week and a half to get fully healthy for the start of the season.
items.title: Theo Johnson (shoulder) practices in non-contact jersey

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints claimed CB Decamerion Richardson off waivers from the Raiders.
items.impact: Richardson will add depth in the corner back room for New Orleans.
items.title: Decamerion Richardson claimed by Saints

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Joe Milton was not claimed on waivers.
items.impact: Milton impressed during his action in the preseason. He could return to the Cowboys on their practice squad.
items.title: Joe Milton III clears waivers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Free agent LB Kyle Van Noy visited with the Vikings on Tuesday.
items.impact: Van Noy could reunite with Brian Flores.
items.title: Kyle Van Noy visits Vikings

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Greg Dortch signed a deal to join the Bills' practice squad on Monday.
items.impact: Dortch was somewhat of a surprise cut by the Lions this past weekend, but it didn't take long for him to find a new employer. The veteran speedster gives the Bills added depth at receiver, as he's been a regular contributor for the Cardinals over the last four seasons. Dortch caught 29 passes over 12 games last season, and he's also a skilled return option.
items.title: Greg Dortch joins Bills practice squad

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Isiah Pacheco (back/MCL) has been placed on injured reserve by the Detroit Lions Tuesday according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Pacheco will be sidelined for at least the first four games of the upcoming regular season, with his first opportunity to return coming ahead of a Week 5 contest against the Arizona Cardinals. Jacob Saylors will slide into the No. 2 running back role behind superstar Jahmyr Gibbs in the Lions backfield after an impressive preseason for the time being, with the Lions likely to add more depth to a shorthanded running backs room prior to the regular season.
items.title: Isiah Pacheco (back/MCL) placed in injured reserve

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Jaguars placed OL Patrick Mekari on injured reserve.
items.impact: Mekari will miss at least the first four weeks of the season. He'll likely be sidelined for longer.
items.title: Patrick Mekari (back) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints signed WR Cedric Tillman to their practice squad.
items.impact: Tillman was released by the Browns. He will add depth in the wide receiver room for New Orleans.
items.title: Cedric Tillman signs with Saints practice squad

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Khalil Shakir did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what Shakir is dealing with. His status will need to be monitored the rest of this week and next week into Week 1.
items.title: Khalil Shakir (undisclosed) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills placed Tyrell Shavers on the reserve/PUP list.
items.impact: Shavers will miss at least the first four weeks of the season. He is recovering from a torn ACL suffered in the playoffs last season.
items.title: Tyrell Shavers (knee) placed on reserve/PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots placed EDGE Harold Landry on the reserve/PUP list.
items.impact: Landry will miss at least the first four games of the season. He has been absent from practice for most of the offseason program.
items.title: Harold Landry III (knee) placed on reserve/PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt returned to practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt was absent from practice for the past week. He should be on track to be good to go for Week 1.
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) returns to practice

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colts GM Chris Ballard said Keenan Allen will play in Indianapolis' Week 1 game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Allen was arrested for DWI and DWI endangering a person on Sunday morning. He'll be in the WR4 range for fantasy managers heading into the season.
items.title: Keenan Allen will play in Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed EDGE Sam Williams to a one-year contract.
items.impact: Williams was released by the Cowboys. He will add depth on the defensive line for Cleveland.
items.title: Sam Williams signs with Browns

title: Fantasy Player News
